page.title: Ingress
page.description: Hostnames this environment serves, their certificates, and the nodes that serve them.

routes.label: Routes
routes.filterPlaceholder: Filter by hostname, stack or service

claim.detail: A stack holds this name but none of its services serves it.

reserved.detail: Held back on the <domains>Domains tab</domains>. No stack can claim it.

empty.title: No routes yet
empty.body: A route appears when a stack has tierplan.ingress.* labels and is deployed. The Expose panel in the stack editor writes them.

reasons.not_attached: {{service}} isn't on the ingress network. Redeploy the stack to attach it.
reasons.stack_stopped: The stack is stopped. Its hostnames stay reserved for it.
reasons.no_certificate: No certificate has been asked for yet.
reasons.not_in_bundle: The proxies' settings don't include this route yet.
reasons.no_nodes: No node is enrolled to serve it.
reasons.nodes_behind: On {{applied}} of {{total}} nodes. The rest are still updating.
reasons.engine_unreadable: TierPlan couldn't read this environment just now.
reasons.no_bundle: Ingress hasn't published its settings yet.

off.title: Ingress is off
off.body: Ingress serves your stacks' hostnames over HTTPS, with a certificate for each name. It is off for this environment, so no route is served.
off.reader: Ask an Admin to turn it on.

alerts.unreachable: TierPlan can't reach this environment just now. What you see may be out of date.
alerts.paused: Ingress is paused after a restore. Nothing is written to the swarm until an Admin resumes it.
alerts.resumeFailed: Couldn't resume ingress. Nothing was changed.

certs.label: Certificates
certs.renewBasis: How the renewal time is chosen

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.body: A certificate is ordered when a stack claims a hostname under a registered domain, or when you request one.

budget.label: Certificate budget
budget.line: {{domain}}: {{used}} of {{cap}} new certificates used in the last 7 days.
budget.lineStaging: {{domain}} (staging): {{used}} of {{cap}} new certificates used in the last 7 days.
budget.noHeadroom: TierPlan orders no more until a slot opens <time/>.
budget.shared: Other names under {{domain}} share this budget.

request.title: Request a certificate
request.helper: Under a domain registered on the Domains tab. TierPlan orders it before a stack claims the name.

upload.title: Upload a certificate for {{host}}
upload.helper: TierPlan stores the key sealed and never shows it again.

switch.title: Switch {{host}} back to Let's Encrypt?
switch.body: TierPlan orders a certificate from Let's Encrypt for this name. The uploaded certificate keeps serving until the new one is ready or it expires.
switch.done: Ordering a Let's Encrypt certificate for {{host}}.

nodes.label: Ingress nodes

empty.title: No nodes enrolled yet
empty.body: A node appears here when its ingress proxy connects. If none does, check the proxy service on the Swarm page.

nodes.tokenMounted: The join token it held may still be mounted.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.body: This node stops serving routes now and its key is refused. It can't enrol again with the join token it holds, unless you allow that below.
revoke.reasonHelper: Shown in the node table and the audit log.
revoke.allowReenrol: Let this host enrol again with the join token it still holds
revoke.doneBody: Rotate the join token. It is still mounted in that node's container.
revoke.held: This node may still hold the keys for: <names/>. Request new certificates for them.

vip.title: Virtual IP
vip.off: The virtual IP is off. Turn it on in Settings.
vip.offLinked: The virtual IP is off. Turn it on in <settings>Settings</settings>.

holder.many: More than one node holds the address

foreignRouter.title: Another router uses this router ID

clock.title: A node's clock is out of step
clock.body: {{nodes}} are too far from the others. The virtual IP rejects adverts more than {{window}} s old, so the nodes may stop hearing each other. Fix the clock on those nodes.

managers.label: Managers
managers.localSocket: Reached through TierPlan's own Docker socket, so it counts as allowed.
managers.unreadable: TierPlan couldn't read the managers just now.

reason.probe_failing: The previous holder's proxy stopped answering.
reason.disabled: The virtual IP was turned off.

domains.label: Domains
domains.offLine: Domains can be registered before ingress is on.

reserved.title: Reserved names
reserved.helper: A hostname under {{suffix}}. No stack can claim it.

empty.title: No domains yet
empty.body: Register a domain to let stacks in this environment serve hostnames under it. TierPlan needs a DNS token to prove it owns the name.

add.title: Add domain
add.domainHelper: A suffix such as apps.example.com. Hostnames must be below it.
add.stagingHelper: Staging certificates aren't trusted by browsers and TierPlan never serves them.
add.tokenHelper: TierPlan tests the token before it saves the domain. It is stored sealed and never shown again.

changeIssuer.title: Change the issuer of {{suffix}}
changeIssuer.loading: Reading what the change would do
changeIssuer.paragraph: Certificates under {{suffix}} that came from the other Let's Encrypt directory are retired and ordered again from {{issuer}}.
changeIssuer.uploads: These uploaded certificates are left alone:

replaceToken.title: Replace the DNS token for {{suffix}}
replaceToken.helper: TierPlan tests the new token before it replaces the saved one. It is stored sealed and never shown again.

delete.title: Delete {{suffix}}?
delete.body_one: Its {{count}} certificate stops renewing and expires. Hostnames under it can't be claimed any more.
delete.body_other: Its {{count}} certificates stop renewing and expire. Hostnames under it can't be claimed any more.

ingress.title: Ingress
ingress.enableFailedBody: Turning ingress on failed. The objects it made are still in the swarm. Turn it on again to carry on, or off to remove them.
ingress.disablingIncompleteBody: Turning ingress off didn't finish. Something is left in the swarm. Turn it off again to remove it.
ingress.pendingWipes_one: {{count}} certificate cache volume is still to be wiped on a node TierPlan couldn't reach.
ingress.pendingWipes_other: {{count}} certificate cache volumes are still to be wiped on nodes TierPlan couldn't reach.
ingress.redeploy_one: {{count}} stack needs a redeploy to join the ingress network.
ingress.redeploy_other: {{count}} stacks need a redeploy to join the ingress network.
ingress.offBody: Ingress serves your stacks' hostnames over HTTPS on this environment, with a certificate for each name.

redeploy.title: Stacks to redeploy
redeploy.note: Redeploy them after this finishes so they join the ingress network.

review.unreachable: These nodes aren't connected now. Their certificate cache volume is wiped when they connect: {{nodes}}.
review.jobUnreadable: TierPlan can't read this job any more. Check the page again for where ingress stands.

enable.title: Turn on ingress?
enable.body: TierPlan makes a join token, the ingress network and a proxy on each node. Stacks and their labels are not changed.
enable.failedHint: Nothing is lost. Turn it on again to carry on, or off to remove what was made.

disable.title: Turn off ingress?
disable.body: Routes stop being served on this environment. Stacks and their labels are not changed.
disable.failedHint: Nothing is lost. Turn it off again to remove what is left, or on to carry on.
